system.name: TV-Rec
system.one_liner: A sequential recommender that replaces fixed convolution kernels and self-attention with time-variant graph filters, giving each sequence position its own filter taps.

content.variant_note: the same multiply-and-sum convolution drawn twice on one 5-column grid, once with a single shared filter and once with a filter per node
content.argues: A fixed filter applies the same taps at every node, whereas a time-variant filter gives every node its own filter, drawn as differently coloured filters, arrows and outputs.
content.subject: Convolution on a line-graph view of a 3-signal sequence (K = 2, zero-padded): shifted filter copies multiply the signal and sum into outputs.

lessons.what_to_learn: To show how a new operator differs from a standard one, draw the same computation twice on an identical grid and change only the colour coding (one colour for a shared parameter set versus one colour per position), letting arrows and outputs inherit those colours.
lessons.suits: Operator-level contrasts such as shared versus position-specific weights, convolution versus attention, or fixed versus adaptive filters, where structure is equal and only parameter sharing differs.

sections: Why we need time-variant graph filters (p.6)
evidence: Arrow colors show each filter’s contribution to the output yj, while different hi box colors represent different filters.
the time-variant convolutional filter in (b) allows each node to have its own filter.
The output yj, i.e., the filtered signal at index j, is produced by summing the filtered results.

summary: TV-Rec replaces the fixed convolution kernels and self-attention of sequential recommenders with time-variant graph filters that give each sequence position its own filter taps. Figure 1 compares the two operators on a line-graph view of a sequence with three signals x0 to x2 (K = 2, zero-padded). Both panels share one 5-column grid: staggered rows of filter-tap boxes sit above the signal row, Multiply arrows run down into it, and Sum arrows collect the products into outputs y0 to y2. In (a) all filter boxes and outputs share one light blue; in (b) each node's filter has its own colour (blue, purple, pink), carried into its arrows and its output.
summary_zh: TV-Rec 用随位置变化的图滤波器取代固定卷积核与自注意力。图1在同一网格上并排画出两种算子：(a) 所有位置共用同一个蓝色滤波器，(b) 每个节点有各自颜色的滤波器，箭头与输出同色，乘法后求和得到 y0 至 y2。
notes: The index lists this figure as chart/bar; it is a box-and-arrow diagram with no bitmaps and live text. Arrow colour codes the output each product feeds (blue y0, navy y1, grey-violet y2 in (a); blue, purple, red in (b)), not the tap index. Red arrows are #bc5e5b in the SVG fills, which the digest list omits.
